card.title: ARRACOURT
card.text: The Battle of Arracourt was a 1944 tank battle between US and German forces.
card.flavorText: The Battle of Arracourt (September 18-29, 1944) was a key WWII tank battle in theLorraine region in France between US and German forces. The American 4th Armored Division, despite facing poor visibility and being outnumbered, used superior tactics, combined arms, and air support to counter the German Fifth Panzer Army’s attempt to halt the Allied advance in France. The Americans destroyed over 200 German tanks and assault guns while losing only about 55 of their own, marking a decisive victory that furthered the Allies' push toward Germany.
